name: SISO Session Intelligence
summary: A privacy-reduced learning pipeline that turns explicitly supplied Claude and Codex sessions into traceable goals, failures, decisions, intentions, wins, recurring patterns, and durable local recall.

evidence.summary: Canonical public source contains explicit Claude and Codex adapters, pre-persistence redaction, append-only event identity, typed insights, deterministic importance, recall, export, synthetic fixtures, and publication checks.

license.reason: The clean SISO-owned implementation carries MIT; user-supplied transcripts remain external and retain their own privacy and rights.

evidence.summary: Source provenance, warehouse exclusions, raw-transcript boundary, and license scope are recorded at the pinned release.

relationships.context: Session Intelligence may project selected privacy-reviewed insights into Agent Brain, while raw sessions and the learning database retain an independent lifecycle.

evidence.summary: The architecture separates session learning from shared operational state.
Warehouse adapters, append-only event log, typed extraction schema, scoring, recall, runtime behavior, provider coupling, and private paths were read before classification.
Both provider fixtures, idempotent ingest, privacy redaction, recall, export, database-content inspection, and publication scan passed; checkpoint rated 94/100.
